title: Garnac
subtitle: Let the Hunt Begin!
text:
While an opponent controls a <uq> unit, this unit gains Hidden.
When Attack Ends: You may attack with another unit.
rules:
If a unit has Hidden and Sentinel at the same time, it can be attacked.
Units must be ready in order to attack.
When Attack Ends abilities trigger at the same time the attacking unit deals combat damage. Garnac does not need to survive the attack for you to attack with another unit.
